title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 32: the song of Moses about the Rock, and Moses sent up Mount Nebo.

questions.text: To what does Moses compare his doctrine at the start of the song?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew."

questions.text: What name does the song use for God, whose "work is perfect"?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just."

questions.text: According to the song, how did Yahweh keep Jacob in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says he found him in a desert land, cared for him, and kept him as the apple of his eye.

answers.text: As a lamp in the darkness
As the apple of his eye
As a seal on his hand
As a tent in the desert

questions.text: Yahweh's care is compared to which creature stirring up her nest?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young."

questions.text: What did Jeshurun do after he grew fat?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says Jeshurun grew fat and kicked, and abandoned God who made him.

answers.text: He kicked and abandoned God who made him
He gave thanks and built an altar
He divided the land among his sons

questions.text: To whom did they sacrifice, according to the song?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says they sacrificed to demons, not God, to new gods their fathers did not dread.

answers.text: To the sun and the moon
To the kings of the nations

questions.text: How could one chase a thousand and two put ten thousand to flight?
questions.explanation: Verse 30 says this could only happen if their Rock had sold them and Yahweh had delivered them up.

answers.text: They had better swords and many more chariots
Their enemies were asleep in their tents at night
Their camp was on a high and fortified mountain
Their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up

questions.text: The song says "their vine" is of the vine of which place?
questions.explanation: Verse 32 says: "For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah."

questions.text: Where did Yahweh tell Moses to go up?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to go up into the mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo in the land of Moab, across from Jericho.

answers.text: Mount Nebo in the land of Moab

questions.text: Where, according to Yahweh, did Moses trespass against him?
questions.explanation: Verse 51 says it was at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin.

answers.text: At the waters of Meribah of Kadesh
At the shore of the Red Sea
At the foot of Mount Sinai
